dependency_reachability_repair_v01: {"op": "write", "path": "query.sql", "content": "WITH RECURSIVE reach(tenant,source,target) AS (SELECT tenant,source,target FROM edges WHERE status='active' UNION SELECT r.tenant,r.source,e.target FROM reach r JOIN edges e ON e.tenant=r.tenant AND e.source=r.target WHERE e.status='active') SELECT tenant,source,target FROM reach WHERE source<>target ORDER BY tenant,source,target"}
quota_prefix_repair_v01: {"op": "write", "path": "query.sql", "content": "WITH ranked AS (SELECT *, SUM(units) OVER(PARTITION BY tenant,queue ORDER BY priority DESC,request_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS used_units FROM requests WHERE status='active') SELECT tenant,queue,request_id,used_units FROM ranked WHERE used_units<=capacity ORDER BY tenant,queue,priority DESC,request_id"}
